description: This file defines the 'Fixer' class within the OpenCart catalog currency extension namespace. It contains methods for fetching exchange rate data from the Fixer.io API, processing currency conversions, and updating currency values in the system.

classes.name: Fixer
classes.description: A controller class for updating currency exchange rates using the Fixer.io API within the OpenCart system.

methods.name: currency
methods.description: Fetches latest currency rates from Fixer.io API and updates the system currencies accordingly.
